description: This file defines the Root controller for the Coocook web application, implementing various actions such as index, homepage, dashboard, statistics, about, and internal methods for request handling and redirection. It manages request preprocessing, access control, URL generation, and view rendering logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Root
classes.description: Controller class handling root-level web actions and request preprocessing for the Coocook application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Handles the initial request, enforces HTTPS redirection if necessary.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Prepares common data for views, such as user info and configuration.

methods.name: auto
methods.description: Performs automatic checks and setups before actions, including user authentication and URL setup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the root URL, displaying recipes of the day or redirecting based on user capabilities.

methods.name: homepage
methods.description: Renders the homepage with recent recipes and projects.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Displays the user's projects and related data.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes view rendering, handles access control for menu items, and sets security headers.

methods.name: _validated_redirect
methods.description: Validates and performs a redirect based on a URL parameter, ensuring security.
